description: Fixed build requests that measure the builder. Do not change a case after a report uses it. Add a new case instead.

cases.request: Turn raw meeting notes into a short summary, a list of decisions, and action items with owner and due date when the notes give them. Mark action items that have no owner. Return structured JSON.

Read the text of an invoice and extract the invoice number, issue date, seller, buyer, line items (description, quantity, unit price), tax and total. Check that the line items add up to the total and flag a mismatch.
Take a raw job posting and return the title, seniority, must-have skills, nice-to-have skills, salary range if given, remote policy, and a list of red flags.
Compare a CV text with a job description. Return a 0-100 fit score with explicit weights, the matched skills, the missing skills, and three interview questions about the gaps.

Classify a customer support email as billing, bug, feature request, cancellation, or other, and rate its urgency. Draft a reply for billing and bug emails. Send angry customers and cancellation threats to a human.
Score an inbound B2B lead from a contact form (name, company, role, message) from 0 to 100 with explicit weights. Route hot leads to a personal reply draft and cold leads to a nurture tag.
Moderate a user comment: decide if it is spam, harassment, hate, self-harm risk, or fine. Give a confidence and a short reason. Send uncertain cases to a human.
Write a product description for an e-commerce listing from a list of features. Keep it under 120 words, use a friendly tone, and do not invent features.

Translate a product description into a target language with a native marketing tone. Keep brand names unchanged, stay within 15 percent of the original length, and adapt units and currency formats to the locale.

Given a company name, research it on the web and write a one-page brief: what it does, founding year, headquarters, key products, recent news from the last 12 months with source URLs, and three questions a sales rep can ask.
Given a product category and a region, find the five main competitors on the web. For each one give the website, pricing model, and one strength and one weakness, with sources.
Given a topic, find the three most important news items of the last seven days and write a digest with one paragraph and one source link for each item.

List the investment funds in Turkey (TEFAS) that gave investors the highest returns in the last 10 years, analyze them (annualized return, volatility, maximum drawdown), and return a list of funds that are worth considering.
Given two currency codes and a number of days, get the daily exchange rate history and report the minimum, the maximum, the average, and the percent change over the period.
Given a city name, get the next 3 days of weather forecast (min and max temperature, chance of rain, wind) and write a short outlook with clothing advice for each day.
Answer a customer question using only a policy document that is given as input. Quote the policy sentences that support the answer, and say clearly when the policy does not cover the question.
Review a contract text and list risky clauses (auto-renewal, unlimited liability, unilateral changes, data sharing, non-compete), each with severity, a quote, and a plain-English explanation.
Draft a reply to a customer complaint email and send the draft to a human for approval. Return the final approved text, or the rejection reason.

For each new post on the Hacker News newest feed (https://hnrss.org/newest), decide if it is about AI or machine learning. If it is, write one sentence about why it matters. If not, tag it as skipped.
Given a public GitHub repository (owner/name), get its stars, open issues, last commit date, and contributor count from the GitHub API, and rate the health of the project with a short explanation.
Turn the notes of a daily standup meeting into structured JSON: for each person, what they did yesterday, what they plan to do today, and their blockers. Mark a person who gives no plan for today.
Given a base currency, a target currency, and a number of weeks, get the daily exchange rates and report the average rate of each week and the largest change from one day to the next.
Read the text of a shop receipt and extract the store name, the date, the items (name, quantity, price), the tax, and the total. Check that the items add up to the total and flag a mismatch.
Compare several short CV summaries with one job description. Give each candidate a 0-100 fit score with explicit weights, list the matched and the missing skills, and rank the candidates.

Classify a refund request email as damaged item, late delivery, wrong item, changed mind, or other, and rate its priority. Draft a reply for damaged and wrong items. Send requests above 500 USD to a human.
Moderate a product review: decide if it is spam, fake, offensive, off-topic, or fine. Give a confidence and a short reason. Send uncertain cases to a human.
Write a short event announcement from a list of event facts (name, date, place, speakers). Keep it under 100 words, use a warm tone, and do not invent facts.
Answer an employee question using only an HR handbook text that is given as input. Quote the handbook sentences that support the answer, and say clearly when the handbook does not cover the question.

Review an NDA text and list the risky clauses (unlimited term, one-sided obligations, a broad definition of confidential information, no return of materials, an unusual jurisdiction), each with severity, a quote, and a plain-English explanation.
Given a city name and a trip date in the next 5 days, get the weather forecast for that day and say if the day is good for a walking tour, with the reasons.
